## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: special driving situations: night driving, work zones, rural roads, winter driving and trailering
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The figure of about forty thousand work zone injuries a year and the national trailer towing mileage are the manual's own statistics with no source year, so they are isolated as dynamic [A03].
The winter skid advice to pump standard brakes gently while holding steady pressure with ABS is reported exactly as printed [A08].
The trailer pages carry pictures that the text does not describe, and physical page 138 carries no text; only the printed text is used, and the cargo split is reported as printed [A10].
The part of the manual after this section is a practice-app note with sample questions and is not mapped to any section.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
